title: The Oathstone
text: Knights once swore oaths at this standing stone, and hundreds of their names are carved on its face, the oldest worn almost smooth. One name has been gouged out. Something else is written over it, in letters that hurt to look at.

options.label: The bravest swears an oath on the stone, beside the hundreds who swore before.

outcomes.text: The stone takes the oath. So does the one who swore it, who is bound to it now for good or ill.

options.label: The sharpest reads what was written over the gouged name, though it hurts to look.

outcomes.text: It is a curse on an oathbreaker, and the name of a House you know.

options.label: Break the stone, and every oath sworn upon it.

outcomes.text: Every oath ever sworn on it is released. The air feels clean.
Every oath ever sworn on it is broken. The oathbreakers wake.
